whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Restro & Cafe De'Laila,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.8★ reviews in the Fraser Road Area, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, full food menu, aur special dining atmosphere showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/delaila

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Restro & Cafe De'Laila, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and mobile-first food menu showcase for Fraser Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
